title: Pinebark Solutions onramp — ops scratch
body:
Quick scratchpad from 2025-11-12 intake + follow-ups (notes to self). Status: exploratory pre-PoC, customer wants private deployment but wants fast ramp to a hosted MVP first

Context:
- Pinebark Solutions (telecom analytics) — wants near-real-time call transcription enrichment, on-device/edge prefiltering + Redwood-hosted inference for higher-quality reranking and entity extraction.
- Primary constraints: 99th pct latency <= 120ms for short requests (seq len ~80 tokens), GDPR/telecom regulator in EU — needs KMS + audit logs.
- Business driver: reduce false positives in alarms by 30% vs current rule-based system; this feeds into automated remediation pipeline.

Attendees (11/12 intake):
- Pinebark: Clara M. (CTO), Ravi K. (SRE lead), Ana P. (Data engineer)
- Redwood: Avery (SE), Ethan (Solutions), Priya (Security SME)

High-level ask:
- Start with Redwood Hosted API for prod-lite MVP (to get latency and model tuning fast), then transition to Redwood Private (VPC) within 6–8 weeks for EU data residency + dedicated capacity.
- Need deterministic cost estimates for 10k reqs/min and for peak 30k reqs/min.

Key technical notes:
- Dataflow: streaming RTP -> internal ASR -> chunked segments (avg 1.5s, 25 tokens) -> Redwood chat/generation endpoint for entity extraction + reranking.
- ASR currently inserts filler tokens and inconsistent punctuation -> prompt engineering + post-token-cleanup needed. Flag: tokenization mismatch between their ASR punctuation and model’s tokenizer caused hallucinated entities in quick test.
- Latency model: most time is network + prefix KV warmup on cold-models. Suggest: enable prefix caching for common customer prompts and use warmup policy on model startup (pre-warm batch of frequent templates).
- Model choices: prefer an Llama2-variant 13B quantized T4-optimized for cost. Discussed fallback to smaller 7B for burst capacity. Need profiling job to confirm token/sec on their median sequence length.
- Security: must support BYOK via Cloud KMS or HSM (customer prefers external HSM). Also need encrypted audit logs delivered to their S3 bucket in eu-central-1.
- Networking: they require private egress to their VPC. For Hosted MVP we propose IP allowlist + dedicated subnet + VPN tunnel (short-term) then full Redwood Private VPC in phase 2.

Gotchas / risk flags:
- ASR <> tokenizer mismatch (see above) — will bias extraction. Immediate mitigation: run small eval set through candidate model to quantify entity precision/recall delta.
- Burst protection: their traffic pattern has heavy bursts at 03:00UTC daily -> autoscale policy must support fast ramp + fallback model to avoid throttles.
- Cost surprise: continuous streaming -> long context windows; recommend KV prefix caching and truncation heuristics to avoid quadratic cost on long calls.
- Regulatory: they will want annual penetration test report and SOC2 addendum for telecom data. Need security lead to confirm timeline for Private deployment approval.

Open questions (to resolve before PoC kickoff):
- Exact retention window for logs/audit (30/90/365 days) -> affects storage + cost. (Action: Clara to confirm)
- Do they require token-level redaction before logs leave their edge? If yes, implement local pre-filter before sending to Redwood hosted for MVP.
- HSM vendor and compliance attestation required for BYOK (Priya to confirm supported vendors).

Immediate next steps / owner map:
- Avery: draft PoC scope + a simple hosted MVP config with model choices and expected qps/cost estimate by 2025-11-19. Link to SUP ticket: SUP-1423.
- Ethan: schedule profiling run (13B / 7B quantized) against their sample transcripts; capture p95 latency and tokens/sec. Target: 2025-11-18.
- Priya: validate HSM options + compliance checklist and estimate additional time for Private approval. Target: 2025-11-20.
- Clara (customer): share 1k sample transcripts (anonymized) and confirm audit retention window. Target: 2025-11-15.

Action items (short):
- Create a small evaluation harness to run their ASR output through 3 model configs + minimal prompt cleaning (Avery/Ethan). Ticket created.
- Put together a quick cost calc sheet for 10k qps baseline and 30k burst scenario (include quantized T4 and g4dn estimates).
- Draft a short one-pager for Clara describing Hosted MVP -> Private migration plan + expected timeline (2–3 slides).

Notes to self:
- Keep migration path simple: Hosted API with dedicated endpoint + prefix caching -> identical config mirrored into Private (minimize prompt changes).
- Watch out for tokenization edge-cases: numbers + timestamps in transcripts cause weird splits; include normalization step in pre-processing code snippet.
- Add test: "ASR token-to-model-token ratio" to profiling harness so we can estimate token inflation.

Meeting cadence proposal:
- Weekly sync for first 3 weeks (Mon 30m), then biweekly during Private rollout.

Misc quick links:
- Internal playbook: onboarding-private-deploy.md (ask infra for latest checklist)
- Related SUP ticket: SUP-1423 (cost + profiling)

End of scratchpad — will tidy into a PoC brief once profiling numbers available.
